about: Chelsea is a municipality in Quebec’s Collines-de-l’Outaouais, in the Gatineau Hills facing Ottawa—not Chelsea in other countries, and not the City of Gatineau. Old Chelsea, Meech Lake, and large parts of Gatineau Park define this rural-residential hill community. About 8,000 people live in Chelsea.
seoSummary: Gatineau Hills municipality of Old Chelsea and Meech Lake—Gatineau Park doorstep, not the City of Gatineau.
